parsed.name: E-255压电定位器
parsed.description: 用于显微实验中的高精度压电定位设备，可按通道移动到指定位置并读取当前位置、行程上下限、控制就绪状态以及部分通道信息，常用于精密调焦或纳米级位移控制。
parsed.description_en: A high-precision piezo positioning device for microscopy experiments. It can move a channel to a target position and report current position, travel limits, controller ready status, and channel-related information. It is typically used for fine focus or nanometer-scale motion control.
